hook: 8 clear bins fixed my closet for $29.99

scenes.visual_prompt: Quick pan across a closet shelf stacked with mismatched cardboard boxes and a dollar-store tote with a cracked lid
scenes.on_screen_text: the real cost isn't the mess
scenes.voiceover: If your closet looks like this, you already know the problem.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hands opening four different boxes one after another, frustrated, searching
scenes.on_screen_text: it's opening 4 boxes to find 1 thing
scenes.voiceover: It's the time tax nobody budgets for.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing an 8-pack of clear plastic storage bins with snap lids on the floor
scenes.voiceover: One 8-pack of clear bins, snap lids, reinforced handles — $29.99.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the star rating and review count overlay on the product, then hands snapping a lid closed
scenes.voiceover: That's an unusually strong score for storage at this price.

scenes.visual_prompt: Time-lapse of shelf being restocked with uniform clear bins replacing the mismatched boxes, everything now flush and stacked
scenes.voiceover: One standard bin, not five different ones — that's what makes a shelf read as organized instead of contained.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide reveal shot of the finished shelf, clean and uniform, camera pulls back

caption: I stopped buying random totes and bought one 8-pack instead. Link in bio for the exact bins (4.8 stars, 3,672 reviews) plus the rest of the $29.99-and-up system I used to fix the whole closet.
